$comment: Every error code mixel, the desktop, the registry and the MCP server use. One line each: what it means and the usual fix, then "warn" for the few that are warnings (mixel check --strict and publish refuse those too); every other code is an error, and mixel check exits 1 on it. The exact fix for a case is in the message itself. Generates docs/errors.md and the code lists in Python and TypeScript.

manifest_missing: There is no app.json in the folder.
manifest_json: Fix the JSON at the line shown.
manifest_v0: app.json has no "$schema": it is the old v0 format.
Add "$schema" and "sdk", rename worker.entry to entry and frontend to page, give each permission a reason.
manifest_field: A field app.json doesn't have, or one that was renamed.
Remove or rename it as the message says.
manifest_name: name is not 2 to 48 lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
"name": "my-app". It never changes after the first publish.
manifest_display_name: displayName is missing or over 48 characters.
manifest_summary: summary is not one sentence of up to 80 characters.
"summary": "One file to many formats at once."
manifest_version: version is not MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, or not above the last published one.
manifest_entry: entry is missing, not a .py file, or not in the app.
manifest_page: page is not an .html file in the app, or it isn't built.
manifest_accent: accent is not a colour like #5b8cff.
manifest_icon: icon is not a square .svg or .png in the app.
manifest_window: window sizes are whole pixels within the allowed range.
manifest_license: license is not an SPDX identifier.
manifest_tags: tags is more than 5 single words.
sdk_range: sdk is not a caret range this SDK satisfies.
permission_undeclared: The code uses a permission app.json doesn't ask for.
mixel check --fix adds it; then write the reason in your own words.
permission_unused: app.json asks for a permission the code doesn't use.
Remove it, so people aren't asked for more than the app needs.
template_words: The summary or a permission reason is still mixel new's words about converting, in an app that does something else.
Write what your app does, and why it needs each permission, in your own words.
permission_unknown: Not a permission. They are files, library, library-read, data, gpu and network.
Use one of files, library, library-read, data, gpu, network.
permission_reason: A permission without a reason of 12 to 120 characters.
One sentence that tells the person why, like "Open the songs you choose."
network_hosts: network without a list of hosts, or with the whole web, an IP or localhost.
dependency_missing: The code imports a package pyproject.toml doesn't list, so Mixel won't install it.
dependency_not_installed: A listed package isn't installed where mixel runs, so the actions couldn't be loaded.
lock_missing: pyproject.toml lists packages but there is no uv.lock, so Mixel and the registry can't install exactly what was reviewed.
uv lock, then commit uv.lock. mixel check --fix runs it.
banned_api: The code runs programs, opens raw sockets, runs code from strings, or imports by a name it builds (subprocess, os.system, socket, ctypes, eval, exec, __import__, requests).
Use ox.audio.convert, ox.audio.read or ox.audio.write instead of programs; urllib.request with a declared network for downloads; plain imports.
path_outside: The code opens a fixed path outside the app, like /etc/passwd, /tmp or the home folder.
Use the files the person chooses (ox.Files, ox.Folder), ox.temp() or ox.data.
app_failed_to_load: The entry file raised an error while loading.
Fix the error at the line shown; the message names the fix.
no_actions: The entry file has no @ox.action functions.
@ox.action("Title") above a function makes it an action.

bad_input: The input doesn't fit the action's controls. Python never sees it.
Send each control's value, as the message says.
problem: The action raised ox.Problem: something the person can fix.
Show the message and hint to the person.
cancelled: The person pressed Stop. kept lists what the action finished before.
Nothing to fix. Show what was kept.
crashed: The action raised an unexpected error, or the app stopped.
Read the log (mixel dev prints it), fix the line, run again.
timeout: The action ran longer than its timeout.
@ox.action("Title", timeout=3600), and call ox.progress so Stop works.
permission_denied: The page used a file the person didn't choose, or a permission they turned off.
Use ox.files.pick or a Files control; ask the person to allow it.
permission_undeclared: The app used a permission app.json doesn't declare. Declared is binding.
Add it to app.json › permissions with a reason.
unavailable: The page isn't running inside Mixel, or the app has no actions.
Open the app in Mixel (mixel dev).

folder_not_empty: mixel new would write into a folder that has files.
no_tests: There are no tests in tests/.
Add tests/test_app.py with a unittest that calls ox.test(...).
tests_did_not_run: Run python -m unittest in the app's folder to see the whole error.
no_such_action: mixel run named an action the app doesn't have.
Use a name mixel check lists.
no_such_topic: mixel docs named a page that doesn't exist.
desktop_unavailable: Mixel isn't running, or developer mode is off.
Open Mixel, turn on Settings › Developer mode, then quit and reopen Mixel.
desktop_error: The desktop refused or failed a dev request.
Follow the message; mixel doctor checks the setup.
expired_token: The pairing code expired before it was confirmed.
network: Check the connection. MIXEL_API sets another address.
registry_unavailable: This cloud doesn't take that request from the CLI yet.
Update the server, or set MIXEL_API.
registry_error: Follow the message and its doc link.
git_failed: The app's folder must be a git repository pushed to GitHub.
git_dirty: There are changes that aren't committed.
git add -A && git commit -m "…" && git push
git_not_pushed: The commit isn't on GitHub yet.
not_repo_root: The app isn't at the top of its git repository.
Give the app its own repository.
not_github: The remote isn't a GitHub repository.
Push the app to a public GitHub repository.

library_search_off: Mixel is closed, or Let an assistant search your Library is off.
The person opens Mixel and turns it on in Settings › Your assistant.
not_ready: Mixel can't compare sounds yet: the sound model is off or still indexing. Search by words still works.
Search with words instead, or ask the person to check Mixel.
unknown_id: An id that no search in this Mixel session returned, or one it no longer remembers.
Search again and use the ids it returns.
too_many: More than a search or a crate takes: 5 avoid or unlike words, 50 sounds in a crate.
Keep the ones that matter most.
crates_off: Proposing crates is off in this Mixel, so nothing was made.
Tell the person what you found; they can turn on Settings › Your assistant › It can propose crates.
unknown_tool: Mixel has no tool by that name.
too_long: Mixel's answer was over its limit, so it wasn't sent.
Ask for less: fewer words, or a narrower filter.
mixel_error: Mixel couldn't answer, for a reason it keeps to itself.
Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the person.

github_required: The Mixel account has no GitHub account connected, and reviewers read the code there.
Connect GitHub on your account page, then publish again.
repository_invalid: repository isn't a GitHub repository like github.com/owner/repo.
Push the app to GitHub and publish from its folder.
repository_not_yours: The repository isn't one of the public repositories GitHub shows for the connected account.
Push the app to a public repository you own, or connect the GitHub account that owns it.
commit_invalid: commit isn't the full 40-character SHA of a commit.
commit_not_pushed: The commit isn't on GitHub yet.
message_invalid: The note for reviewers is over 500 characters.
submission_pending: A version of this app is already waiting for review.
mixel status shows it; publish again once it is decided.
app_required: The request doesn't name the app.
Name it as app.json does: mixel status in the app's folder does this.
rate_limited: Too many requests in a short time, like more than 10 submissions in an hour.
Wait, then try again; the message says how long.
waitlisted: The account is on the waitlist, so only sign-in, sign-out and the account's own data answer.
Wait for the email that says you're in.
terms_required: The account hasn't agreed to the Terms of Service.
Open cloud.0x1audio.com, agree, then run mixel login again.
plan_required: The account's plan doesn't include this; the error names what it needs.
See the plans on your account page.
